claims.value: DeepSeek-V3.1 is a hybrid model supporting both thinking and non-thinking modes via chat template change, with improved tool calling, agent tasks, and thinking efficiency.
claims.evidence: DeepSeek-V3.1 is a hybrid model that supports both thinking mode and non-thinking mode.
DeepSeek-V3.1-Think achieves comparable answer quality to DeepSeek-R1-0528, while responding more quickly.
Smarter tool calling: Through post-training optimization, the model's performance in tool usage and agent tasks has significantly improved.
Toolcall is supported in non-thinking mode.
The prefix of thinking mode is similar to DeepSeek-R1.
Toolcall is supported in non-thinking mode. The format is...<｜tool▁calls▁begin｜>...
DeepSeek-V3.1 is trained using the UE8M0 FP8 scale data format on both model weights and activations
